hook.name: AutoExitHook
hook.description: Owner-managed hook that maintains three automated tick-range liquidity positions (lower, middle, upper) in a Uniswap v4 pool. The owner triggers rebalancing manually via triggerRebalance() or updateConfig(), which removes stale positions, optionally swaps to rebalance token balances, and re-adds liquidity within configured tick ranges. The afterSwap rebalance callback is currently disabled (commented out).
